## What is still open
- **#1412 is approved but not ready to merge**: Elad requires an audit event per batch (id range, count, from/to KEK), not just the final summary, for PCI traceability. Avi wants this in and the PR merged by Monday. [3]

## What changed
- Shira needs two items from the production run for Ardent’s assessment: **the rotation audit-log export and the signed change ticket**, by **Wednesday 25 November**. [5]
- The production window is confirmed for **Tuesday 24 November, 22:00–23:30 IL**, with Elad on call with you. The only fallback is Thursday 26 November, same time, before the 1 December change freeze. [6]

## What you did
- Built and opened **#1412**, the card-vault KEK rotation job: legacy v1 tokens map explicitly to `vault-kek-2022`, rewritten tokens use v2 envelopes, dry-run and resume are supported, and a final audit event is emitted. The staging dry run passed all **1,204,880 tokens**, and all **212 vault tests** pass. [1][3]
- Wrote the production runbook covering pre-checks, replica dry run, the real run, verification, decrypt-only retention of old keys for 30 days, and failure recovery: re-wrapped tokens remain valid, so fix the cause and resume with `--from-id`. [2]
